Same barrage context: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17…
sources: Zaporizhzhia regional authorities + Ukraine emergency services, via Economic Times / New Indian Express (Nov 3)
fault_line: Double-tap on an aid site: deliberate targeting or collateral of a 'military target' claim?

sections.what_happened: Death toll from the Nov 2 Russian double-tap strike on the Komyshuvakha school/aid distribution point and shelter rises from 29 (recorded 2100-05) to 31 killed, with 45+ residents still missing; rescuers continued searching rubble Nov 3. Same barrage context: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles overnight Nov 2-3 across nine regions (Zelenskyy, via AJ); Kharkiv hospital strike injured 73 (already recorded Nov 3).
sections.what_verified: Two distinct families reporting the revised toll (ET family and NIE family — both Indian outlets but distinct publishers; counted conservatively as 2 families for a toll correction only, not as an outcome claim).
sections.what_disputed: Earlier same-day figures (24, then 26, then 29) show the toll moved as bodies were recovered — the 31 figure may itself move; 45+ missing keeps the final toll open.
sections.why_matters: Toll correction only — no new video; a line inside any Ukraine-barrage follow-up, with the scope (aid-site strike, Nov 2) stated in the headline per the toll-scope rule.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Nov 3 afternoon, absent from all Nov 4 scans): Komyshuvakha aid-centre strike toll revised 29 -> 31 killed, 45+ still missing
